settings.threshold_rule: pooled validation negative 95th percentile (higher); p>t predicts positive
settings.review_score: -|logit(p)-logit(t)| + (1-q); disease scores clipped to [1e-6,1-1e-6] for logits
settings.quality_score: raw regression score clipped to [0,1] for applying the review rule
settings.capacity_rule: quality rule cutoff from reference folds, >= cutoff in held fold; baselines rank by negative logit distance with sample_id ascending on ties
